pain_point: Later Euler calls are stateless even though the first M27 call is strong. Multi-step and long-refiner quality can therefore fail to preserve a good initial estimate.
minimal_change: Store the previous detached x0 block estimate in HierarchyState and map it through a zero-initialized low-rank 3D residual before the next backbone call. The first call has no history and is exactly M27.
promotion_gate: Joint legalized cost and V_rel improvement over the matched control with feasibility 1.0 and no area/b2b collapse.
falsification: Non-identical first-call output, either primary metric regresses, or only the training curve improves.

quick_result.decision: Reject M40. Latent/rho/area training-curve gains reverse at the legalized endpoint; cost, area, and b2b intervals all exclude zero in the harmful direction.

boundary: Frozen subset mechanism screen only; no full-data or SOTA claim.
